title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. In the first face, draw a two-dimensional sketch consisting of a loop with four lines. The first line starts at the origin [0.0, 0.0] and ends at [0.043, 0.0]. The second line starts at [0.043, 0.0] and ends at [0.043, 0.0059]. The third line starts at [0.043, 0.0059] and ends at [0.0, 0.0059]. The fourth line completes the rectangle by starting at [0.0, 0.0059] and ending at the origin [0.0, 0.0]. Apply a scale factor of 0.043 to the entire sketch to adjust its size. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero degrees and translating it with a vector set to zero. Extrude the transformed sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction to create a three-dimensional solid body. This solid body will have a length of 0.04296875 units, a width of 0.005859375000000001 units, and a height of 0.7500000000000001 units. The resulting shape is a cylindrical object with a rectangular section at the top.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the rectangular section
r = r.box(0.043, 0.0059, 0.75, centered=(False, False, False))

# The final model is represented as 'r'

lanes.label: Cadabra 4B (ours) · best of 8
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.043, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.043, 0.0059) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0059) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.75)
